assessments.reasoning: The Go Authors' go1.23.0 tag resolves to 6885bad7dd86880be6929c02085e5c7a67ff2887. This exact publisher resource is the specification labelled language version go1.23. The fresh full-response digest equals the registered source revision's digest. The go-statement clause assigns evaluation and execution to different goroutines. The arguments belong to the ordinary call-evaluation part even when execution of the invoked body is asynchronous. The go statement is a valid call and evaluation of the call's function value and arguments completes normally. This does not determine the scheduler's execution order between the remainder of the caller and the new goroutine or map goroutines to operating-system threads. Evaluating a call argument may itself block or panic. That does not put argument evaluation into the eventual new goroutine.
